blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The HECKTOR 2026 challenge benchmarks machine learning for head and neck cancer, where teams delineate primary and nodal tumour volumes, perform TN staging, and predict recurrence-free survival (RFS). This report describes the submissions for the HECKTOR challenge of team nucli. As the three tasks span both dense and global information from multicentric PET/CT scans, we utilise self-supervised pre-trained encoders, training a 2D DINOv2 encoder (PET-DINOv2-MIPs) on HECKTOR 2026's PET scans. Our final test submission ensembles a DynUNet trained from scratch with a SwinUNETR whose Swin trunk was initialised from a SimMIM-pre-trained checkpoint for segmentation, reaching a mean Dice of 0.5409. For TN staging, GTVp/GTVn geometric features from the segmentation masks are fit to stage probabilities by logistic regression (LR) and fused with PET-DINOv2-MIPs deep features (PCA + LR) via a second-level LR, reaching balanced accuracies of 0.3962 (T-stage) and 0.6432 (N-stage). For the RFS prognosis task, we fine-tune the last two blocks of the PET-DINOv2-MIPs ViT-S encoder jointly with an MLP head under a CoxPH loss, concatenating clinical covariates with the imaging features, reaching a test Harrell's C-index of 0.6577 and a weighted challenge score of 0.5802. The prognosis result is comparable to the best entry of the previous edition and consistent with our internal cross-validation, while our segmentation result is well below it and limits the staging results that depend on it.
blocks.zh: HECKTOR 2026挑战基准机用于头部和颈部癌症的学习,团队在其中划定了初级和节点肿瘤体积,进行TN中转,并预测无再生存活(RFS). 本报告介绍了为Nucli团队的HECKTOR挑战而提交的资料。 由于这三项任务跨越了多中心PET/CT扫描的密集信息和全球信息,我们使用自我监督的预先训练的编码器,在HECKTOR 2026的PET扫描上培训了一台2D DINov2编码器(PET-DINOv2-MIPs). 我们最后的测试呈文集合了用SwinUNETR从头开始训练的一款DynUNet,其Swin干线是从一个SimMIM预先训练的检查站关闭的,用于分道扬镳,达到0.5409的平分. 对于TN中转,从分片口罩取出GTVp/GTVn几何特征,适合通过物流回归(LR)进行相位概率,并通过二级LR与PET-DINOv2-MIPs深层特征(PCA + LR)相接,达到0.3962(T级)和0.6432(N级)的平衡速率. 对于RFS的预后任务,我们微调了PET-DINOv2-MIPs VIT-S编码器后两块与CoxPH损失下的一个MLP头相联编码器,使临床同成像特征相配合,达到了测试哈雷尔的C-指数0.6577和加权挑战得分0.5802. 预后结果可与上版的最佳入门相媲美并符合我们的内部交叉验证,而我们的分解结果则远远低于分解结果,并限制了依赖于分解结果的起跑结果.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Treatment options in head and neck (H&N) cancer considerably impact patient quality of
life, even with positive survival outcomes. Selection of a treatment regime that is
curative yet minimises impact on later quality of life is therefore
essential [ 6 ] , which requires an estimate of the
patient’s recurrence risk. Estimating this risk consistently is difficult: current risk
profiling combines noisy factors (self-reported smoking and alcohol history, performance
status, comorbidity, treatment history, and scanner-dependent PET
markers [ 2 ] ) via clinical judgement rather than a fitted
estimator, and not all factors are available in every hospital. Machine learning offers
reproducible risk estimates fitted directly to observed
outcomes [ 16 ] , but whether these transfer beyond
their development cohort is a separate question that single-centre studies cannot answer.

blocks.en:
The HECKTOR 2026 challenge addresses this directly, providing ≈ \approx 700 training cases
from 8 sites, ≈ \approx 50 validation patients from unseen centres, and ≈ \approx 400 test
subjects from three centres (only one overlapping with training), spanning scanner
generations and protocols. It consists of an automated tumour segmentation task and two
image-level tasks, TN staging and recurrence-free survival (RFS) prognosis. Segmentation
provides a label for every voxel of every case. Prognosis provides one time-to-event label
per patient, of which only 148 of 727 in the 2026 training cohort are uncensored events.
From this limited data volume a model must learn both a prognostic representation and
robustness to scanners it has not seen before. The 2025 edition shows the consequence: one
RFS entry reached cross-validation C-index near 0.71, yet fell to 0.53 on the multi-centre
test cohort, while segmentation performance from the same pipeline
held [ 14 ] .

blocks.en:
Self-supervised pre-training (SSL) is a natural response, as it consumes no label
information and can exploit the full imaging distribution rather than only the labelled
subset. We therefore decouple representation learning from the downstream objectives.
Because the three tasks differ in what they require of a representation, we pre-train two
encoders: a DINOv2 encoder on 2D maximum-intensity projections (MIPs) of PET, used for the
image-level staging and prognosis tasks, and a Swin transformer masked image model on 3D
PET/CT, to retain the spatial detail for dense segmentation. Our goal is to evaluate how
well these HECKTOR-only representations transfer to the three tasks, and whether they hold
up across centres between internal cross-validation and the held-out test cohort. We do not
claim a controlled measurement of the benefit of pre-training itself; the reported
experiments do not isolate it (Section 3.4 ).

blocks.en: 2.2 Self-supervised pre-training methods
blocks.zh: 2.2 自我监督的培训前方法

blocks.en: DINOv2
blocks.zh: DINOV2 数据

blocks.en:
is an SSL method known to transfer well to both global
and dense downstream tasks [ 1 ] . It trains a student
Vision Transformer (ViT) against an EMA teacher on CLS tokens
only [ 3 ] , giving strong image-level but weaker
dense features. DINOv2 [ 12 ] adds an
iBOT [ 21 ] loss on masked patch tokens, creating features better
suited to dense tasks. We build on DINOv2, as the newer DINOv3 [ 15 ] is
designed for a billion-image, billion-parameter regime less suited to the smaller datasets
common in medical imaging. We pre-train on 2D MIPs of the provided 3D PET data, since whole
3D PET volumes tend to be largely sparse. The value of MIPs for global tasks has been shown
in earlier work [ 11 ] .

设计用于10亿图像、10亿参数的系统,不太适合较小的数据集
常见于医学成像. 我们预训了2D MIP 提供的3D PET数据,因为整体
3D PET的卷多为稀有. 多边投资方案对全球任务的价值已经显示
在较早的工作[11]。

Each PET volume is processed into 4 MIPs from oblique angles ( 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} , 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} , 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} , 135 ∘ 135^{\circ} ), resampled to 2.0 2.0 mm isotropic pixel spacing, rendered at 480 × 480 480\times 480 and pre-processed with log1p . The backbone is a standard
ViT-S/16 [ 5 ] (dim=384, blocks=12, heads=6, head dim=64,
MLP hidden=1536, ≈ 21.5 \approx 21.5 M parameters), trained on a single NVIDIA A100-80GB for 1600
epochs at batch size 128 128 , with hyperparameters similar
to [ 12 ] . This encoder is used in Tasks 2 and 3 and is
further referred to as PET-DINOv2-MIPs .

blocks.en: SimMIM
blocks.zh: 希姆语Name

blocks.en:
Masked Autoencoders [ 9 ] transfer exceptionally well to dense
tasks such as segmentation, but appear to be outperformed by contrastively pre-trained
encoders on global tasks [ 18 ] , so we use masked image modelling
for the segmentation task only. We pre-train the Swin transformer encoder of
SwinUNETR [ 8 ] ( feature_size = 48 \texttt{feature\_size}=48 , depths ( 2 , 2 , 2 , 2 ) (2,2,2,2) , heads ( 3 , 6 , 12 , 24 ) (3,6,12,24) ) on two-channel (PET, CT) 128 3 128^{3} volumes under the
SimMIM formulation [ 20 ] ,
following [ 17 ] : 32 3 32^{3} patches are masked at a
ratio of 0.6 0.6 and reconstructed under an ℓ 2 \ell_{2} loss, with all-background patches
excluded from the loss. Both modalities are resampled to 1.5 1.5 mm isotropic spacing; PET is
transformed with log1p , CT is windowed to ( − 200,200 ) (-200,200) HU and rescaled to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . Training runs for 800 epochs with Adam (base learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , effective
batch 8).

blocks.en: 2.3 Task 1: Segmentation
blocks.zh: 2.3 任务1:分割

blocks.en:
During the validation phase, leaderboard performance and performance on our in-house
held-out set of 61 patients (random centre-stratified split, seed 42) diverged substantially
across evaluated models, so we adopted an ensembling strategy. Both submitted ensembles
build on a single-stage DynUNet, trained from scratch on the three-class task (background,
GTV p , GTV n ) from PET and CT, resampled to 2 mm isotropic spacing, PET clipped to [0,
15] SUV, CT windowed to ( − 200,200 ) (-200,200) HU, both rescaled to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . Architecture followed
nnU-Net configuration rules [ 10 ] (MONAI 1.4.0
DynUNet): six resolution levels, 3 × 3 × 3 3\times 3\times 3 kernels, five stride-2 downsamplings,
instance normalisation, residual blocks, deep supervision with three auxiliary decoder
outputs. Training: random 128 3 128^{3} patches, 4 per volume, batch size 2 (effective 8), Adam
(lr 0.01, no weight decay, polynomial decay power 0.9), 1000 epochs, augmented with random
affine transforms, axis flips, Gaussian noise, Gaussian smoothing and intensity scaling;
objective softmax Dice over both foreground classes plus voxelwise cross-entropy over all
three. The validation-phase submission paired it with a two-stage variant of identical
configuration (binary lesion mask, 1000 epochs; refined to three classes, 700 epochs, binary
prediction as third input channel).

blocks.en: 2.4 Task 2: Staging
blocks.zh: 2.4 任务2:设置

blocks.en:
TN staging is a multi-class classification problem, evaluated with balanced accuracy, i.e.
recall averaged over the classes of each stage. We combine two classifiers, one on geometric
features from the Task-1 masks and one on PET-DINOv2-MIPs embeddings, the final
classification fused by a second-level logistic regression.
blocks.zh:
TN中程是一个多等分级的分类问题,以平衡的准确性,即评价.
每个阶段的类别平均召回。 我们合并了两个分类器 一个在几何上
PET- DINOv2- MIPs 嵌入式, 最终
由二级后勤回归而成的分类。

blocks.en:
Geometric features (classifier 0a) N-stage labels were corrected by the
organising team using AJCC 7th edition criteria [ 7 ] on the
ground-truth masks; T-stage labels were not, and remain unreliable: geometric derivation
from ground-truth masks reassigns 151 of 189 provided T1 cases and recovers none of the 118
T4 cases (defined by local invasion rather than GTV p \text{GTV}_{\text{p}} characteristics),
while shifting N-stage counts by at most 16 of 782 patients. We therefore do not derive
stage directly from mask geometry, but extract 12 mask features covering the AJCC size,
count and laterality criteria and fit a logistic regression onto stage probabilities: three
for the primary (presence, greatest diameter of its largest connected component, total
volume), four for node burden (presence, largest node diameter, number of node components,
total volume), and five for criteria a single size threshold misses (second-largest node
diameter, bilaterality flag, number of ipsi- and contralateral nodes, largest contralateral
node diameter). Diameters are maximum Feret diameters, laterality is relative to the
primary’s side of the midline, and no minimum-size filtering of nodal components was applied
(threshold of one voxel). On ground-truth masks this gives 0.964 0.964 N-staging balanced
accuracy but only 0.399 0.399 for T.

dominate the regularisation path of the 12 geometric features, so we use late fusion (stacked generalisation [ 19 ] ,

and a level-1 logistic regression learns how much to trust each view per class, 5 fold cross-validated. To avoid
leaking in-sample confidence, the level-1 model is fitted exclusively on out-of-fold level-0 probabilities, with standardisation, PCA and the level-0 classifiers refitted per
fold on patients they never saw. For deployment the level-0 models are refitted on the full
training set, while the level-1 model is kept as trained on the out-of-fold matrix. All
three are multinomial logistic regressions (L-BFGS, ℓ 2 \ell_{2} regularisation, class-balanced
weights against the strong imbalance, in particular N2), with min ⁡ ( 5 , min k ⁡ n k ) \min(5,\,\min_{k}n_{k}) folds:

covariate, giving 8 + 4 = 12 8+4=12 clinical features and a 384 + 12 = 396 384+12=396 -dim input to the survival

blocks.en:
Architecture of the Cox survival head The four per-MIP CLS tokens
are combined by MIP-attention pooling: an attention MLP with tanh \tanh activation computes a
normalised weight per MIP, and the weighted sum gives a single 384-dim patient vector. The
survival head maps the fused 396-dim vector through Linear ​ ( 396 → 128 ) \texttt{Linear}(396\rightarrow 128) , ReLU , BatchNorm , Dropout(0.3) , then a bias-free Linear ​ ( 128 → 1 ) \texttt{Linear}(128\rightarrow 1) outputting a scalar risk (higher risk = shorter RFS). The
Cox PH loss sorts patients by descending time. We tested two paradigms; the complete flow of
the second (submitted) methodology is shown in Fig. 2 . 1. Frozen encoder. Features pooled by masked mean over in-GTV patch tokens,
standardised and reduced by PCA to 16 components, concatenated with the clinical
covariates (PCA applied to the imaging block only), and fitted with an ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -penalised
CoxPH model [ 4 ] ( λ = 0.1 \lambda=0.1 , penalised
partial-likelihood maximisation). Standardisation, PCA and the Cox model are fitted on
the training fold only and applied unchanged to the validation fold. 2. Fine-tuned encoder tail. The last two blocks and final norm of the
ViT-S/16 DINOv2 encoder are fine-tuned jointly with the MIP-attention pooler, fusion MLP
and a bias-free linear Cox head for 140 epochs. Trainable parameters: 3,650,562
total, of which 3,549,696 come from unfreezing the last encoder blocks; the remaining
17,921,280 encoder parameters stay frozen.

blocks.en: 3.4 Limitations
blocks.zh: 3.4 限制

blocks.en:
Most of our development effort went to the self-supervised pre-training pipeline and the
prognosis task, and comparatively little to the segmentation methodology. The test Dice of 0.5409 0.5409 , against 0.75 0.75 for the best 2025 entries, reflects this. Each ensemble member was
submitted as a single-fold checkpoint instead of a 5-fold ensemble, only two members were
combined per submission, and no test-time augmentation was used. Previous editions have been
won by more extensively ensembled pipelines, so ensembling across folds and architectures
would likely recover part of this gap.
blocks.zh:
我们的开发工作大部分都投入了自我监督的预训管道和
预后任务,与分化方法相对较少. 0:5409 0.5409的试验地标,2025年最佳条目为0.75 0.75,反映了这一点。 每个合唱团成员
以单倍式检查站而不是5倍式组合提交,只有两名成员
每个划界案合并,不使用试验时间加长。 前几期已经
由更为广泛的综艺管线所取胜,故综艺跨越折叠和架构
有可能弥补这一差距的一部分。

blocks.en:
Four choices limit the internal evidence. The 61-patient in-house set was split randomly
with centre stratification rather than by centre, and was used during ensemble selection, so
it is a development set. The masks used to fit classifier 0a were inferred for all training
patients, including patients the segmentation models had seen during training. The submitted
prognosis checkpoint is fold 0, selected as the best of five folds; retraining on all
patients or ensembling the folds would have been a possible improvement. Finally, no
prognosis configuration was cross-validated with centre-grouped folds, so none of our
internal estimates measures cross-centre generalisation, despite that being a stated
motivation of this work; that the test C-index landed close to the cross-validation mean is
therefore reassuring but not something the internal protocol was designed to predict.
blocks.zh:
四取法限制内证. 61号病人的内设设备被随意分割
与中心分层,而不是按中心, 并在综艺选秀中使用,所以
这是一个发展集。 用于装入0a分类器的口罩被推断用于所有训练
包括患者 分化模型在训练中见过。 提交的来文
预后检查点为倒数 0, 被选为5个倒数中最好的; 全部重新培训
病人或共鸣 叠叠是可能的改进。 最后,没有
预后配置与中组叠交叉验证,所以我们没有
内部估计措施 跨中心通用,尽管有说明
这项工作的动机;测试的C-index着陆接近交叉验证的平均值是
因此,内部协议是用来预测的,但不能令人放心。

blocks.en:
The experiments also do not isolate the contribution of pre-training itself, which would
require the same architecture, schedule and CV regime with and without SSL initialisation.
The SimMIM-initialised SwinUNETR differs from the from-scratch models in architecture and
optimizer, the DINOv2 staging features are compared against geometric features rather than
against a randomly initialised encoder, and the prognosis comparisons vary the head as well.
Finally, the provided T-stage labels were not cleaned, and CT was not used for staging or
prognosis despite being available.
blocks.zh:
这些实验也并不孤立预训本身的贡献,因为预训本身将促进培训。
需要同样的结构、时间表和CV制度,无论有无SSL初始化。
SimMIM-初始化的SwinUNETR与建筑学和建筑学中的切片模型不同
优化器,DINov2相接特性与几何特性相比较,而不是
与随机输入的编码器相对应,预后比较也不同头.
最后,提供的T级标签没有清洗,CT没有用于中转或
尽管有预后。

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en:
We evaluated self-supervised pre-training for three head and neck oncology tasks in HECKTOR
2026. A PET-DINOv2-MIPs encoder, pre-trained exclusively on HECKTOR data, contributed
features to both TN staging and RFS prognosis, while a SimMIM-pre-trained Swin transformer
supported segmentation. Our final submission reached a weighted score of 0.5802 0.5802 , with a
mean Dice of 0.5409 0.5409 , balanced accuracies of 0.3962 0.3962 (T) and 0.6432 0.6432 (N), and an RFS
C-index of 0.6577 0.6577 . The prognosis result lies within the spread of our internal
cross-validation and is comparable to the best entry of the previous edition, obtained from
PET MIPs and clinical covariates alone. Segmentation was below the state of the art and
limited N-staging, while T-staging is bounded by the label definition rather than by our
models.

模特们

blocks.en:
Future work includes ensembling segmentation predictions across all folds and architectures,
incorporating CT into the staging and prognosis pipelines alongside PET, a matched
pre-trained versus randomly initialised comparison to isolate the contribution of
pre-training, centre-grouped cross-validation for the prognosis branch, and extending
self-supervised pre-training to 3D DINO-style models on PET/CT to better exploit volumetric
context. Overall, the self-supervised pre-trained encoders showed promising transfer
performance on the image-level tasks, with the prognosis branch generalising from internal
cross-validation to the multi-centre test cohort.
blocks.zh:
未来的工作包括所有折叠和结构的全聚分解预测,
将CT与PET并列的中转和预后管道结合使用,匹配
预选培训与随机设置的比较,以孤立
培训前,中心组合的预后分支交叉验证,以及扩展
在PET/CT上对3D DINO型进行自我监督的前期培训,以更好地利用体积
上下文。 总体而言,自我监督的预先训练的编码器显示出有希望的转移
在图像级别任务上的性能,预后分支从内部概括
交叉验证到多中心测试组。
